meetBirendra.title: Senior Executive.
meetBirendra.subheadline: Global Financial Strategy, M&A and Capital Governance
meetBirendra.bioParagraph1: Over more than two decades in international finance and the energy sector, I have built experience across corporate headquarters and complex international operations, with assignments spanning India, Nigeria, Italy, Kenya, South Africa and Iraq.
meetBirendra.bioParagraph2: My career has encompassed financial leadership, corporate reporting, planning and performance management, joint ventures, governance, capital allocation and transaction support across international upstream oil & gas operations.
meetBirendra.bioParagraph3: Working across different countries, cultures and organisational settings has taught me to connect corporate strategy with operational realities while maintaining financial discipline and effective governance. Today, that experience shapes how I approach M&A, capital allocation, financial strategy, risk and controls, technology-enabled finance and enterprise performance.
meetBirendra.capabilitiesLead: I collaborate closely with executive leadership to craft proactive financial frameworks, moving beyond simple financial reporting to accelerate business planning, sustainable expansion, manage international exposure, and maximise the enterprise value.

faq.heading: Common questions
faq.subhead: Practical details regarding consultation scheduling, confidential discussions, and advisory arrangements.

items.question: How do advisory discussions begin?
items.answer: Engagements initiate through a confidential enquiry via the contact section below or direct email. This allows an initial assessment of strategic fit, scope, and objectives.

items.question: How are engagements structured?
items.answer: Arrangements are customized to organizational requirements—ranging from selective board appointments and transaction advisory to ongoing strategic CFO counsel.

items.question: What is the geographic and international scope?
items.answer: Advisory discussions are conducted internationally across Middle East, UK/Europe, Asia, and North American markets, with deep sector expertise in energy, commodities, infrastructure, and international finance.

items.question: Is the conversation confidential?
items.answer: Yes. Engagements are handled with independence and confidentiality appropriate to board-level and executive discussions.

items.question: Do you offer ongoing advisory?
items.answer: Monthly advisory retainers are available by enquiry. Use the contact form or select the retainer option when booking.
